name: Soft Clay Foundation
derivedFrom: reference: soft polymer-clay / claymation stacking blocks — tactile matte 3D toy, premium calm finance vibe

artDirection.theme: soft polymer-clay stacking blocks, calm trustworthy, gentle studio light

negative: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no UI, no watermark
no people, no hands, no faces
no harsh black cast shadows, no dark drop shadow on the ground
not a photograph, no photographic grain, no gritty realism

assets.subject: a soft calming studio backdrop for a clay-toy scene: a smooth gentle vertical gradient from a soft pale blue-white at the top to a slightly deeper pastel periwinkle-blue at the bottom, a soft warm subtle radial glow of light in the upper-middle area, and a faint soft ambient shadow gently pooling toward the lower-centre where objects would rest; clean minimal calm premium, completely empty — no objects, no furniture, no horizon line, no pattern, just soft studio light and a gentle smooth gradient filling the whole frame edge-to-edge

a single horizontal rounded rectangular block made of soft matte polymer clay, a long wide low bar lying flat, smoothly rounded corners and softly beveled edges, VERY LIGHT desaturated warm off-white / pale grey clay (so it can be tinted later), gentle soft top sheen highlight along the upper edge and soft ambient occlusion along the lower edge, tactile hand-made clay surface, viewed straight from the front with a slight 3D thickness

a single horizontal rounded rectangular block made of soft matte polymer clay, a long wide low bar lying flat, smoothly rounded corners and softly beveled edges, warm rich GOLD / amber clay with a precious gentle inner glow, soft top sheen highlight and a faint warm halo, tactile premium hand-made clay surface, viewed straight from the front with a slight 3D thickness

a wide low pedestal base slab made of soft matte polymer clay, a long horizontal plinth with smoothly rounded corners and a softly beveled top edge, calm muted slate-blue clay, gentle soft top light and a subtle top sheen, tactile hand-made clay surface, viewed straight from the front with a slight 3D thickness
